# The prose here is easy; the code is not

You write a loop. It runs. You read the output. Good.

The block below is dense on purpose. If the gate scored code as prose, its long
identifiers and its one enormous statement would push the grade up and trip the
long-sentence lint. The gate must not see it.

```cpp
// instantiation of polymorphic abstractions necessitates comprehensive
// consideration regarding computational ramifications inherent within paradigms
int comprehensiveInstantiationRamification = polymorphicAbstractionConsideration
    + encapsulationPhilosophicalUnderpinning + methodologicalSophistication
    + implementationComplexityProportionality + persistentIntellectualDedication;
```

Even this inline span is `comprehensiveInstantiationRamificationConsideration`
and it must not count either. Short line. Done.
